findings.summary: T16 reuses PR C's plan record scoped to T17–T25, which excludes T16 and therefore fails the plan-scope predicate; require a plan re-review covering T16 before the activation PR.

Closing and reopening a PR whose head predates the workflow does not supply the checker script that the workflow executes from its head checkout, so grandfathering cannot succeed without an additional branch-update or trusted-checker step; T24 inherits this problem.
